name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.normalized_closedCore_principal
statement:
theorem normalized_closedCore_principal (t a b d : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ t a b d ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ t a b d ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    closedCore t a b d * principalNormalizer t a b d =
      satakeNumerator a b / ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.normalized_closedCore_special_negative
statement:
theorem normalized_closedCore_special_negative (t a b : K)
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : satakeNumerator a b ≠ 0)
    (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hf : fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    closedCore t a b (-t) * specialNormalizer t a b (-1) = 1

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.poincare_factorization
statement:
theorem poincare_factorization (t : K) :
    poincare t = (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 * (1 + t ^ 4)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principalAdjointInverse_eq
statement:
theorem principalAdjointInverse_eq (t d : K) :
    principalAdjointInverse t d =
      (1 - d ^ 2 * t ^ 2) * (1 - t ^ 2) * (1 - t ^ 2 / d ^ 2)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.principal_cancellation
statement:
theorem principal_cancellation (t d p n₁ n₂ d₁ d₂ : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ ≠ 0) (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    (p * (1 - t ^ 2) * n₁ * n₂ / (poincare t * d₁ * d₂)) *
      ((1 - t ^ 4) * (1 - t ^ 8) * ((1 - d * t) * (1 - t / d) * d₁ * d₂) /
        ((1 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂ * principalAdjointInverse t d)) =
      p / ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.satakeNumerator_eq
statement:
theorem satakeNumerator_eq (a b : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    satakeNumerator a b = (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_cancellation
statement:
theorem special_negative_cancellation (t p n₁ n₂ f : K)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    (p * (1 - t ^ 2) * n₁ * n₂ / (poincare t * f * p)) *
      ((1 - t ^ 4) * (1 - t ^ 8) * ((1 + t ^ 2) * f) /
        ((1 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 * n₁ * n₂ * (1 - t ^ 4))) = 1

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_d₁
statement:
theorem special_negative_d₁ (t a b : K) :
    d₁ t a b (-t) = fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_negative_d₂
statement:
theorem special_negative_d₂ (t a b : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    d₂ t a b (-t) = satakeNumerator a b

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.special_positive_prefactor
statement: theorem special_positive_prefactor (q x : K) : (1 - (1 : K)) / (q + 1) * x = 0

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_sum_principal_formula
statement:
theorem finite_sum_principal_formula (q t a b d : K)
    (h : FiniteRegular t a b d)
    (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ t a b d ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ t a b d ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hm : 1 - d * t ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + d * t ≠ 0)
    (him : 1 - t / d ≠ 0) (hip : 1 + t / d ≠ 0) :
    (2 / (q + 1) * finiteCore t a b d) * principalNormalizer t a b d =
      2 / (q + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /
        ((1 + d * t) * (1 + t / d))

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_sum_special_negative_formula

    (h : FiniteRegular t a b (-t))
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (hc : poincare t ≠ 0) (hp : satakeNumerator a b ≠ 0)
    (hn₁ : n₁ t a b ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ t a b ≠ 0)
    (hf : fourFactors a b (-t ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) (ht₄ : 1 - t ^ 4 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / (q + 1) * finiteCore t a b (-t)) * specialNormalizer t a b (-1) =
      2 / (q + 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_principal_inverseSqrt
statement:
theorem finite_principal_inverseSqrt (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b d : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /
        ((1 + d * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) * (1 + (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) / d))

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_principal_square_roots
statement:
theorem finite_principal_square_roots (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b d A B : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hd : ‖d‖ = 1)
    (hA : A ^ 2 = a) (hB : B ^ 2 = b)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (A⁻¹ + A) ^ 2 * (B⁻¹ + B) ^ 2 /
        ((1 + d * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) * (1 + (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) / d))

    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (t : ℂ) a b d) *
      principalNormalizer (t : ℂ) a b d =
      2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * (a + 2 + a⁻¹) * (b + 2 + b⁻¹) /

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_special_negative_inverseSqrt
statement:
theorem finite_special_negative_inverseSqrt (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 < q) (a b : ℂ)
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (ha₁ : a - 1 ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b - 1 ≠ 0) (hab : a - b ≠ 0)
    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) :
    (2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1) * finiteCore (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b (-(inverseSqrt q : ℂ))) *
      specialNormalizer (inverseSqrt q : ℂ) a b (-1) = 2 / ((q : ℂ) + 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Algebra.finite_special_negative_unitary
statement:
theorem finite_special_negative_unitary (q t : ℝ) (a b : ℂ)

    (hab₁ : a * b - 1 ≠ 0) (hA : 1 + a ≠ 0) (hB : 1 + b ≠ 0) :

    (hN : ‖T * V * t / d‖ < 1) (hE : ‖(T * V) ^ 2 * t ^ 2‖ < 1)
    (hF : ‖T * U * t ^ 2‖ < 1) (hG : ‖T * U * t ^ 4‖ < 1) (i : Fin 10) :
    HasSum (fun p : i0Region i => i0Shell t d U V T p.val)
      (Algebra.regionTerms t d (T * U) (T * V) (i.castLE (by decide)))

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.hasSum_i0_upper
statement:
theorem hasSum_i0_upper (neg : Bool) (t d U V T : ℂ)
    (ht : ‖t ^ 2‖ < 1) (hK : ‖i0KRatio neg t d V T‖ < 1)
    (hE : ‖(T * V) ^ 2 * t ^ 2‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun p : I0UpperRow neg => i0Shell t d U V T p.val)
      ((1 - t ^ 2) * i0KInitial neg t d V T * (T * V) * (1 + T * V) * t ^ 2 *
        (1 - i0KRatio neg t d V T)⁻¹ * (1 - (T * V) ^ 2 * t ^ 2)⁻¹)

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.i0LowerRow_cartan
statement:
theorem i0LowerRow_cartan (neg : Bool) (n : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :
    cartanIndices 0 (i0LowerRowEquiv neg n).val.1
      (i0LowerRowEquiv neg n).val.2.1 (i0LowerRowEquiv neg n).val.2.2 0 =
      (2 * (n.2.1 : ℤ) + 2 * n.2.2 + 4, if neg then (n.1 : ℤ) + 1 else n.1)

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.i0MiddleRow_cartan
statement:

      (i0MiddleRowEquiv neg n).val.2.1 (i0MiddleRowEquiv neg n).val.2.2 0 =
      (2 * (n.2.2 : ℤ) + 2, (if neg then (n.1 : ℤ) + 1 else n.1) + 2 * n.2.1)

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.i0UpperRow_cartan
statement:
theorem i0UpperRow_cartan (neg : Bool) (e : Fin 2) (n : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :

      (i0UpperRowEquiv neg (e, n)).val.2.1 (i0UpperRowEquiv neg (e, n)).val.2.2 0 =
      (0, (if neg then (n.1 : ℤ) + 1 else n.1) + 2 * n.2.1 + e.val + 1)

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.i0_lower_reindexed
statement:

      ((1 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 * i0KInitial neg t d V T * (T * U * t ^ 2) *
        (T * U * t ^ 4)) * (i0KRatio neg t d V T) ^ n.1 *
        (T * U * t ^ 2) ^ n.2.1 * (T * U * t ^ 4) ^ n.2.2

statement:

name: FourierJacobi.Analysis.masterTerm_damping
statement:
theorem masterTerm_damping (q t d U V T : ℂ) (r : ℤ) (p : LatticeIndex) :
    masterTerm q t d U V T r p =
      T ^ shellHeight r (p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2.1) * masterTerm q t d U V 1 r p

    ‖masterTerm q t d U V (T : ℂ) r p‖ ≤ ‖masterTerm q t d U V 1 r p‖

statement:

    paperC q * paperD1 q a b d * paperD2 q a b d ≠ 0 ∧

    (haε : a ≠ ε) (hbε : b ≠ ε) :
    (∀ T ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Summable (fun p : Fin 8 × Fin 3 × LatticeIndex =>
        ‖weightedLatticeTerm q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) T p‖) ∧
      HasSum (weightedLatticeTerm q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) T)
        (latticeCore q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) T)) ∧
    paperC q * paperD1 q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) *
      paperD2 q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) ≠ 0 ∧
    Tendsto (fun T => ((1 - ε) / ((q : ℂ) + 1)) *
      latticeCore q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ)) T)
      (𝓝[Set.Ioo 0 1] 1)
      (𝓝 (((1 - ε) / ((q : ℂ) + 1)) *
        paperE q a b (ε * (inverseSqrt q : ℂ))))
